shape_hint: A plain straight cylindrical rod with a unified inch thread cut along its entire length (fully threaded all-thread rod), no head; the ends are cut square or chamfered, and length is cut to order (commonly 3 ft / 6 ft / 12 ft stock).

notes: UNC columns only. UNF TPI (3+ sources agree: boltingspecialist, astma193, mechanicalc/aptp where overlapping): 1/4-28, 5/16-24, 3/8-24, 7/16-20, 1/2-20, 9/16-18, 5/8-18, 3/4-16, 7/8-14, 1-12, 1-1/8..1-1/2 -12 (UNF stops at 1-1/2). 8UN (8 tpi) for 1-1/8 through 4 (boltingspecialist, astma193, aptp). Umax = 2P thread run-out (0.100 for 1/4-20 ...) listed on boltingspecialist/torqbolt only - not tabulated. Materials (A193 B7, A307, F1554, F593) do not change thread geometry. Class 2A fit is the usual.

verification.checks_done: Re-downloaded all 7 URLs live (HTTP 200), parsed UNC tables, aligned by major diameter. 24 rows x 3 value columns (tpi, d2, As) (+ D = decimal of label, checked in efunda/threadspec/fbc/mechc/bspec). Agreeing clusters (excluding the Boltport and TorqBolt microsite entries): tpi: 4 clusters on every row except 2-1/4 (3: efunda, threadspec, aptp; fbc differs); d2: 1/4 and 5/16 = {efunda, threadspec, fbc} = 3, 7/16..4 in = 4 (aptp joins), 2-1/4 = {efunda, threadspec, aptp} = 3; As: 4-5 on all rows except 2-1/4 = 3 {efunda, threadspec, aptp}. Only disagreement in the whole matrix: flangeboltchart 2-1/4 (4 tpi / d2 2.0876 / As 3.16 vs 4.5 / 2.1057 / 3.25 on efunda, threadspec, aptp, plus Boltport/astma193 tpi 4.5) -> record is right. Physical: d2 = D - 0.649519/tpi within 5e-5 on all 24 rows; As = pi/4 (D - 0.9743/tpi)^2 within 0.14 %; tpi non-increasing 20..4, d2 and As strictly increasing. As printed digits equal the sources (1.9 = 1.90, 2.5 = 2.50, 4.0 = 4.00).
problems: d2 on rows 1/4 and 5/16 and all three columns on 2-1/4 rest on exactly 3 clusters. flangeboltchart.com is needed for 1/4 and 5/16 (aptp starts at 3/8) yet it has a demonstrably wrong 2-1/4 row; its other rows match efunda/threadspec exactly.

efunda, threadspec, flangeboltchart, aptp, mechanicalc all reproduce the same ASME B1.1 / Machinery's Handbook UNC table; counted independent because layouts differ and unrounded minor-diameter values differ in the 4th decimal (e.g. 5/8 minor 0.5168 vs 0.5167).
boltingspecialist.com is the Boltport group and astma193.com is a TorqBolt microsite: the producer listed them as separate sources; they are not needed (and were not counted) for any cell.

Thread data (ASME B1.1 UNC), not ASME B18.31.3 itself (B18.31.3 only adds length/straightness/tolerance rules); UNC only - A193 B7/F1554 rods above 1 in are usually threaded 8UN, which this table does not give; 1-5/8 and 1-7/8 have no UNC and are omitted.

Role check: D = 'Major Dia' decimal of the size label, tpi = 'Threads Per Inch', d2 = 'Pitch Dia' / 'Basic Pitch Dia.', As = 'Tensile Stress Area' / 'Stress area' / 'Tensile Area'; all read from headers.
